cells.gaps: The amendment to POPIA for AI and privacy by design (ZAF-012) is described as work under way with no bill or draft, so 'under revision' rests on that statement alone. ZAF-005's fines carry no event date (only the 2026-09 publication), so they are read as activity, not applied; they set nothing.
cells.note: POPIA is in force, health-information regulations were gazetted on 6 March 2026, the Regulator is constituted and acting, and its 2024/25 annual report counts 745 complaints resolved for the year to 31 March 2025, inside the 24 months. Stage 5 is the top rung, so no cap applies; ZAF-005 is read as activity rather than the applied it carries.
